name: Domaine Pierre Usseglio & Fils Châteauneuf-du-Pape Cuvée de mon Aïeul 2020
text:
## Usseglio Cuvée de mon Aïeul 2020

**Story.** This is Usseglio's top red. It comes from vines 75 to 90 years old, all Grenache from three sites: [Les Serres](https://www.google.com/maps?q=Les+Serres,+Chateauneuf-du-Pape,+France&t=k) (galets), [La Crau](https://www.google.com/maps?q=La+Crau,+Chateauneuf-du-Pape,+France&t=k) (clay) and [La Guigasse](https://www.google.com/maps?q=La+Guigasse,+Chateauneuf-du-Pape,+France&t=k) (sand).

**Reviews.** Jeb Dunnuck gave the 2020 97 points, checked on his site; an earlier barrel range there was 96–98. The dealer J.J. Buckley reports Wine Advocate 93 and Vinous 95. I could not open those two originals, so treat them as dealer-reported. CellarTracker community score, from your list: 95.7 (2020).

**Practical note.** Dunnuck suggested 2022–2042, so it is early in its window. Decant for 90 minutes. It would suit venison or roast duck with figs.

**Curious aside: sand, clay and pebbles.** The three plots in the blend are three different soils, and the blend is built to balance them. The pebbles bring heat, the clay holds water, and the sand adds perfume and finesse.

### From the history books
- 1923: Baron Pierre Le Roy of Château Fortia drafts Châteauneuf's production rules, the first Appellation Contrôlée rules in France. See [Baron Le Roy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special:Search?search=Pierre+Le+Roy+de+Boiseaumarie&go=Go).
- 1863: phylloxera is first documented in France at Pujaut, Gard. It hit Châteauneuf in the early 1870s. See [Great French Wine Blight](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Great_French_Wine_Blight).
- 1954: the town passes its "flying cigar" law banning UFOs. See [Châteauneuf-du-Pape AOC](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ch%C3%A2teauneuf-du-Pape_AOC).

**Sources:** Jeb Dunnuck (subscriber site, checked directly), Uncorked, Falstaff, Farr Vintners, J.J. Buckley, Vinfolio, FRW, First Bottle, Kysela, Benchmark Wine, K&L, Whwc, Thatchers, Winewithseth, CellarTracker, Delectable, closdesspiritueux.com, and Wikipedia ([Châteauneuf-du-Pape AOC](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ch%C3%A2teauneuf-du-Pape_AOC), [Nahe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nahe_(wine_region)), [Vouvray AOC](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vouvray_AOC), [La Clape](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Massif_de_la_Clape), [Avignon Papacy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Avignon_Papacy), [Great French Wine Blight](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Great_French_Wine_Blight)).
